title: Riverbend Patient Financial Services Policy: Patient Changes, Skips and Cancellation of a Patient Payment Plan
content:
**1. Changes.** The patient may change the due day to another of the tier's due day options or ask for a lower installment, together at most the tier's number of changes over the plan's life.

**2. Lower installment.** The clause "A requested lower installment may not be below the tier's lowest requested percentage of the installment computed at creation or at the last recomputation, and never below the minimum monthly payment; the schedule lengthens accordingly but never beyond the maximum term from the first due date" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**3. Skips.** The patient may skip an installment, moving it to the end of the schedule, at most the tier's number of skips.

**4. Cancellation.** The patient may cancel an active **Patient Payment Plan** at any time without penalty; the remaining balances return to the standard statement cycle and no collection action may follow sooner than the tier's default notice period after the cancellation date.

### Counting changes (clause 1), hypothetical tier allowing 2 changes

| Changes already used | Request | Within the allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | a new due day | Yes |
| 1 | a lower installment | Yes |
| 2 | a new due day | No |

A due-day change and a lower-installment request draw on the same count. A patient cancelling on the 10th of a month on a tier with a 30-day default notice period faces no collection action on the returned balances until 30 days after the 10th.

superseded_clauses: A requested lower installment may not be below min_requested_installment_pct_of_computed of the installment computed at creation or at the last recomputation, and never below min_monthly_payment_usd; the schedule lengthens accordingly but never beyond max_term_months from the first due date.
